_about: WP B3 error-catalogue fixtures. 'recorded' = copied from real stream-json lines in this machine's own conversation store (CLI 2.1.2xx, July 2026), with session ids and uuids replaced by fixed placeholders. 'constructed' = a real field layout (taken from recorded lines) with values for a case that was not observed live. No secrets anywhere. 'expect' is one entry per line: the error code, or null when the line is not an error.
